analysis.summary: Krishana Phoschem reported a 35% year-on-year growth in Q1 FY27 revenue to ₹532 crore and a 36% increase in EBITDA to ₹89 crore despite global supply disruptions and high raw material prices. Management highlighted that capacity utilization stood at 43% for its NPK-DAP unit and 121% for its SSP unit during the quarter. The company expanded its complex fertilizer portfolio with new NPK grades, executed a 5-for-1 stock split, and expects quarterly revenue run-rates exceeding ₹500 crore over the remainder of FY27. Krishana Phoschem reported its Q1 FY27 financial results, with quarterly revenue growing 34.58% YoY to ₹532.3 crore and Profit After Tax growing 53.88% YoY to ₹47.06 crore. The company's expanded capacities at Meghnagar for NPK/DAP (165,000 MTPA) and Sulphuric Acid (99,000 MTPA) are now contributing progressively to performance.

guidance.claim: The company expects to achieve an additional 30%–35% turnover over the previous year as production from its expanded capacity normalizes.
guidance.quote: We are hoping that over the remaining quarters, we will be able to smoothen our production, and we will be able to achieve an additional 30%–35% turnover over last year.

guidance.claim: Management expects quarterly revenue to exceed ₹500 crore across the remaining three quarters of FY27.
guidance.quote: We expect to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27, supported by improved capacity utilization and production.

guidance.claim: Management expressed confidence in building on operational momentum through the remainder of FY27.
guidance.quote: We are confident of building on this momentum through the remainder of FY27, as we continue strengthening India's agri-future for our farmers, partners, & shareholders

guidance.claim: The company expects to deliver over 40% growth across key parameters during the current year.
guidance.quote: Accordingly, we expect to deliver growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current year.

guidance.claim: Management expects expanded capacity to add around Rs. 500 crore in top-line revenue in FY27.
guidance.quote: So, you expect an increase of around Rs. 500 crore more, Rs. 2,900 to Rs. 3,000.

guidance.claim: The company targets overall revenue growth of 35% to 40% in FY27.
guidance.quote: So overall, we hope 35%-40% revenue growth in FY27.

guidance.claim: The company expects to import approximately 150,000 metric tons of material generating around Rs. 1,000 crore in revenue in FY27.
guidance.quote: For FY27, based on market demand, we expect to import around 150,000 metric tons of material, which would translate into approximately Rs.1,000 crore of revenue.

demand_outlook.claim: Cumulative rainfall was nearly 40% below normal by June end, leading to a 22.7% decline in national Kharif sowing.
demand_outlook.quote: By the end of June, cumulative rainfall was nearly 40% below normal, resulting in national Kharif sowing declining by 22.7% year-on-year to 182.7 lakh hectares, compared to 236.5 lakh hectares during the corresponding period last year.

demand_outlook.claim: A revival in rainfall during early July accelerated sowing, improved farmer sentiment, and boosted fertilizer offtake.
demand_outlook.quote: However, rainfall improved materially during early July, resulting in a rapid recovery in sowing progress, improved farmer sentiment, and accelerated fertilizer offtake across several key markets for the remainder of the Kharif season.

demand_outlook.claim: The phosphatic fertilizer sector is well-positioned for sustained growth based on strong demand fundamentals.
demand_outlook.quote: The phosphatic fertilizer sector is well-positioned for sustained growth, supported by strong demand fundamentals.

demand_outlook.claim: Improving monsoon conditions, higher MSP, and NBS subsidy support are creating a favorable operating environment.
demand_outlook.quote: Improving monsoon conditions, higher MSP & continued government backing through the Nutrient Based Subsidy (NBS) framework are creating a favourable operating environment.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic stock levels and a favorable monsoon forecast indicate a constructive Kharif demand environment.
demand_outlook.quote: With comfortable domestic stock levels & a favourable monsoon forecast, the Kharif season demand environment appears constructive for the industry.

demand_outlook.claim: Management believes domestic fertilizer manufacturers are unlikely to face demand pressure.
demand_outlook.quote: From our perspective, domestic manufacturers are unlikely to face demand pressure.

demand_outlook.claim: A stable agricultural environment and favorable monsoon outlook support a constructive demand outlook.
demand_outlook.quote: On one hand, a stable agricultural environment supported by a favorable monsoon outlook provides a constructive demand outlook.

demand_outlook.claim: Industry P&K production reached 15.76 lakh metric tonne during the peak Rabi season.
demand_outlook.quote: This was reflected in strong industry performance with P&K production reaching 15.76 lakh metric tonne during the peak period, marking one of the highest monthly output levels.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expanded its complex fertilizer portfolio by introducing new product variants during the quarter.
capex_expansion.quote: During the quarter, in response to evolving crop nutrition requirements and the growing demand for balanced nutrient applications across our key markets, we strengthened our product portfolio by introducing additional variants of complex fertilizers, further expanding our offerings to meet the evolving nutrient requirements of Indian agriculture.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is evaluating capacity expansion opportunities that are pending Board approval and disclosure.
capex_expansion.quote: We are currently evaluating certain capacity expansion opportunities.

capex_expansion.claim: Krishana Phoschem will procure green ammonia from a third party under an arrangement with the Government of India.
capex_expansion.quote: See this capacity of green ammonia is of a third-party capacity and we will buy this green ammonia with an arrangement from the Government of India, Department of Fertilizer one thing.

capex_expansion.claim: Expanded capacities of NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA at Meghnagar are contributing progressively to performance.
capex_expansion.quote: Our expanded capacities at Meghnagar — NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA — are now contributing progressively to our performance.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expanded its NPK/DAP capacity by 50% to 495,000 MTPA, taking total phosphatic fertilizer capacity to 615,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: NPK/DAP capacity enhanced by 50% to 495,000 MTPA and existing SSP capacity at 120,000 MTPA, taking total phosphatic fertilizer capacity to 615,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: Backward integration capacity for sulphuric acid was strengthened to 99,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: Backward integration strengthened with sulphuric acid capacity of 99,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: The company entered into a 10-year Green Ammonia Sale Agreement for 70,000 MTPA under the National Green Hydrogen Mission.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of our long-term sustainability strategy, Krishana Phoschem has entered into a 10-year Green Ammonia Sale Agreement (GASA) under India’s National Green Hydrogen Mission for 70,000 MTPA.

capex_expansion.claim: Management currently has no additional capex or expansion plans beyond implemented projects.
capex_expansion.quote: No, so far, we have not planned anything. Whatever we have, it has been implemented.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin stands at approximately 7%–8% for the trading business and around 16% for the manufacturing business.
margins_costs.quote: The EBITDA margin is approximately 7%–8% for trading and around 16% for manufacturing.

margins_costs.claim: The company successfully passed on roughly 25% to 30% of raw material cost increases through subsidy revisions and MRP adjustments.
margins_costs.quote: Overall, we have been able to pass on ~ 25%–30% of the increase in input costs.

margins_costs.claim: Q1 FY27 EBITDA reached ₹89 crore, representing a 36% year-on-year growth.
margins_costs.quote: Quarterly EBITDA stood at ₹ 89 crore, reflecting a 36% year-on-year growth, supported by disciplined cost management, despite volatility in raw material prices.

margins_costs.claim: Sulphur prices climbed from ₹65,000–₹70,000 per tonne in April to nearly ₹1 lakh per tonne in June and July.
margins_costs.quote: Sulphur prices have risen from around ₹65,000–₹70,000 per tonne in April to almost ₹1 lakh per tonne in June and July.

margins_costs.claim: Lower-cost inventory carried forward from the previous quarter contributed to elevated EBITDA margins in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: Yes, the inventory carried forward from the previous quarter at lower costs did contribute to the higher EBITDA margins.

margins_costs.claim: Q1 FY27 Profit After Tax grew 53.88% YoY to ₹47.06 crore due to improved operating efficiency and disciplined cost control.
margins_costs.quote: Quaterly Profit After Tax grew 53.88% YoY to ₹47.06 crore, reflecting improved operating efficiency and disciplined cost control.

margins_costs.claim: Q4 FY26 EBITDA reached Rs. 90 crore, registering a 59% YoY growth.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA came in at Rs.90 crore, registering a 59% YoY growth, supported by operating leverage from higher volumes and stable cost management despite input price volatility.

margins_costs.claim: Full year FY26 EBITDA increased to Rs. 298 crore, up 62% YoY.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased to Rs.298 crore, up 62% YoY, supported by improved operating performance, and a favourable product mix.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA per ton for manufactured products was in the range of Rs. 5,500 per ton in FY26.
margins_costs.quote: It was in the range of Rs.5,500 per ton.

margins_costs.claim: The trading business generates an EBITDA margin of 5% to 6%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin is 5% to 6% in in trading business.

orders_capacity.claim: Total fertilizer production reached 89,747 metric tonnes in Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved fertilizer production of 89,747 metric tonnes, showcasing our consistent operational efficiency.

orders_capacity.claim: In Q1 FY27, capacity utilization was 43% for the NPK-DAP unit and 121% for the SSP unit.
orders_capacity.quote: 43% capacity utilization of NPK-DAP unit and 121% capacity utilization of SSP unit, which was beyond the core.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's total NPK-DAP capacity reached 495,000 MT following a 165,000 MT expansion.
orders_capacity.quote: Our existing NPK-DAP capacity is 330,000 MT, and we have added another 165,000 MT, taking the total capacity to 495,000 MT.

orders_capacity.claim: Sales volumes in Q1 FY27 were 53,500 MT for NPK-DAP and 36,300 MT for SSP.
orders_capacity.quote: For NPK-DAP, it was 53,500 MT, for SSP 36,300 MT

orders_capacity.claim: Trading sales volume reached 21,000 MT in Q1 FY27.
Fertilizer production reached 94,103 MT during Q4 FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved fertilizer production of 94,103 MT, driven by peak Rabi season demand and improved operational throughput

orders_capacity.claim: Total fertilizer production reached 397,263 MT for full year FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved total production of 397,263 MT, supported by High demand across markets

orders_capacity.claim: In FY26, manufacturing volumes were around 383,000 metric tons and trading volumes were approximately 93,000 metric tons.
orders_capacity.quote: Trading volumes were approximately 93,000 metric tons, while manufacturing volumes were around 383,000 metric tons.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's rock phosphate beneficiation capacity is around 200,000 tons with utilization currently between 50% and 75%.
orders_capacity.quote: The beneficiation capacity is around 200,000 tons, and current utilization is in the range of 50% to 75%.

capital_allocation.claim: The company completed a 5-for-1 stock split, subdividing the face value of shares from ₹10 to ₹2.
capital_allocation.quote: Recently, the company successfully executed a 5-for-1 stock split, subdividing the face value of our equity shares from ₹ 10 per share to ₹ 2 per share.

capital_allocation.claim: Following plant commissioning, depreciation increased to ₹13 crore and finance costs rose to ₹20 crore.
capital_allocation.quote: Depreciation increased from around ₹8.7 crore to ₹13 crore, while finance costs increased from around ₹13 crore to ₹20 crore.
Collection is more than Rs. 700 crore.

capital_allocation.claim: Disciplined capital allocation is highlighted as one of the company's five core strategic pillars.
capital_allocation.quote: Our strategic blueprint rests on five core pillars: backward integration, capacity expansion, product diversification, disciplined capital allocation and deep farmer connect.

capital_allocation.claim: Capacity expansions were funded using internal accruals and term loans.
capital_allocation.quote: This expansion has been funded through a prudent mix of internal accruals and term loans, reflecting disciplined capital allocation.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's effective borrowing interest cost ranges between 6% and 7.5%.
capital_allocation.quote: Overall, the effective interest cost is in the range of 6% to 7.5%.

capital_allocation.claim: Non-subsidy receivable levels normally range between 50 and 55 days.
capital_allocation.quote: But for subsidy, our receivable levels are normally in the range of 50-55 days.

risks_headwinds.claim: The phosphatic fertilizer industry faced supply disruptions, high input costs, and geopolitical volatility in Q1 FY27.
risks_headwinds.quote: The 1st Quarter witnessed a challenging operating environment for the phosphatic supplier industry, primarily driven by global supply-side disruptions, elevated raw material prices, and geopolitical uncertainties.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical tensions surrounding the Strait of Hormuz created uncertainties in global fertilizer supply chains.
risks_headwinds.quote: Geopolitical tensions in West Asia, particularly surrounding critical shipping lanes through the Strait of Hormuz, introduced considerable uncertainty across global industry, global fertilizer supply chains during the quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: Raw material availability was the primary operational challenge faced during Q1 FY27.
risks_headwinds.quote: The primary challenge during the first quarter was the availability of raw materials.

risks_headwinds.claim: Global input market trends firming from mid-February increased cost pressure during late Q4 FY26.
risks_headwinds.quote: However, from mid-February onwards, global market witnessed firming trends driven by supply-side constraints, tightness in gas-linked production, higher logistic and freight costs.

risks_headwinds.claim: The domestic fertilizer industry relies on imports for approximately 90% of key intermediates.
risks_headwinds.quote: Given the industry's reliance on imports for ~90% of key intermediates, these global movements had a direct impact on cost structure.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets an additional 30%–35% turnover growth over the previous year as production from new capacity normalizes.
management_commitments.quote: We are hoping that over the remaining quarters, we will be able to smoothen our production, and we will be able to achieve an additional 30%–35% turnover over last year.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects quarterly revenue to remain above ₹500 crore for the rest of the financial year.
management_commitments.quote: We expect to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27, supported by improved capacity utilization and production.

management_commitments.claim: The green ammonia supply arrangement is scheduled to commence in FY29.
management_commitments.quote: And this capacity will start in FY29 after 2 years.

management_commitments.claim: Management committed to delivering over 40% growth across key parameters during the current year.
management_commitments.quote: Accordingly, we expect to deliver growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current year.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects capacity expansion benefits to reflect in performance from FY27 onwards.
management_commitments.quote: With enhanced capacities now operational, we expect the benefits of this expansion to meaningfully reflect in our performance from FY27 onwards, supported by improved scale, operating leverage, and better efficiency levels.

management_commitments.quote: As per the contract, the green ammonia plant is expected to commence operations in the third year, so we expect supply after approximately three years.
